Board 4, '0 right', traced each tick: x=-0.01 y=0.611, x=0.31 y=0.724 on the ramp; x=1.30 y=1.022, x=1.67 y=1.027 in flight. Pushed up into the ramp side from z=1.4 the ball stops at z~1.24 and slides along; pushed left at the high end it stops at x=1.067 under the slab edge; on the slope y stays radius above the top face.

'0 right' on board 4 takes the (2.2,1.2) coin at tick ~105 with y~0.96, x~2.0 (in flight). roll.py --board 4 --ticks 600 --inputs "0 right,84 none,230 down,266 up,302 right,352 none,400 left,430 none" -> screen won, score 30, coins [] (one life lost on the way); from --board 3 the chained script ends won with score 60.
--board 1..4 in en/es/fr: 'Board N of 4', 'Tablero N de 4', 'Plateau N sur 4' for N=1..4; frames show 'BOARD 2 OF 4', 'PLATEAU 1 SUR 4' etc.

Language row: Right en->es->fr->en, Left en->fr. With fr saved: title Commencer/Reglages/Quitter, settings Reglages/Volume/Langue: Francais/Balle: Normale/Retour, play Plateau/Score/Vies, pause Pause/Reprendre/Retour a l'accueil, won Victoire, lost Partie perdue; language fr; frames show the same.

Settings texts: Volume, Language, Ball, Back (menu_down order Volume->Language->Ball->Back). Ball Normal by default; Left -> Light, Right -> Heavy (stops at ends); ball_kind light/normal/heavy follows; shown as Ligera/Pesada, Legere/Lourde/Normale in es/fr.

Board 2, '0 right' with ball light/normal/heavy: x at tick before strike -0.4732 for all three (also with two other scripts, identical); sum of 6 crate displacements 120 ticks after strike: light 1.478, normal 2.244, heavy 19.623 (other scripts: 1.28<2.79, 0.99<4.48).
Run setting volume 6, es, heavy in folder v1; next run in v1 starts 6/es/heavy; settings.json holds ball. A pre-change file {"volume":6,"language":"es"} loads as 6, es, ball_kind normal.
All 24 m-items re-checked on the changed game and pass (see m01-m24).
--board 4 --frame f4a.png: 800x480 PNG; looked at it: slab, ramp drawn as a tilted slab with raised +x edge, shaded ball at start, the three coins; at tick 85 two coins left, ball on the ramp.
CHANGES.md lists each change with the files touched, what was checked (check.py additions, CLI runs, PNGs looked at), edited old checks and things found wrong before.

defects: Board 2: after the ball strikes the wall, crates end up overlapping each other (light ball tick 188: crate 4 at (0.09,0.27,-0.02) inside crate 1 at (0.10,0.25,0.00); normal ball: crates 2 and 5 0.07 apart; heavy ball: two crates 0.11 apart). They overlap with every ball mass, so the fault may predate the change.

Board 2 with a normal ball and right held: the ball stays pressed against the crate wall at x~-0.07 for 600 ticks. After the first knock the crates stop and do not move again however long the push is held, so the wall then acts like a fixed wall.
